attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculates New Jersey state income tax per Form NJ-1040. NJ uses progressive tax brackets ranging from 1.4% to 10.75% (2025). Personal exemptions are $1,000 per taxpayer and $1,500 per dependent. Starting with federal AGI, subtracts retirement income (Social Security, military pensions, Railroad Retirement are exempt), applies exemptions, and calculates tax using progressive brackets.

initial_action.action_postfix: "NEW JERSEY FORM NJ-1040 - State Income Tax Calculation" job.audit_trail swap addto 0 local@ num_taxpayers > 0 local@ num_dependents > result.agi /result.nj_agi xdef
